_readme: Mob spawn tuning: which mobs spawn in which biomes, and how often. Applied at world load by
kubejs/server_scripts/worldgen/mob_spawns.js as one biome modifier of patcherMod's type creativeengineering:tune_spawns
(CEConfig [worldgen.systems] mobSpawns). Rejoin the world after editing. Unlike worldgen, spawns change in existing
worlds too, but only for mobs that spawn from then on.
Reference + tests: feature_writeup/mob_spawns.md. Preview the result without the game:
python3 tools/gen_spawn_table.py (reads the last /dumpspawns and applies this file to it).
The rules run after every mod's biome modifiers, in this order, one biome at a time.
id      unique, lowercase a-z 0-9 _ (names the biome tag creativeengineering:mob_spawns/<id> and the log lines)
mob     entity id. A mob of a mod that isn't loaded is skipped with a warning.
action  set    spawn at 'weight' (and 'min'/'max' group size when given). Where the mob already spawns its
entries become one, in place; where it doesn't, it is added to 'category' (default: the mob's
own), group 1-1 unless min/max are given. weight 0 = remove.
scale  every existing weight times 'factor' (rounded, at least 1; 0 = remove). Never adds the mob.
remove the mob leaves the biome, every category.
where / add / except   biome selection, as in wild_crops.json: 'where' clauses are OR'ed, the traits in a clause
AND'ed, '!trait' must not hold; traits come from the 'biomes' table in wild_crops.json (overworld only).
'add' takes biome ids or '#tags' (Nether and End biomes go here); 'except' takes biome ids and only removes
biomes the clauses or ids matched, not members of an added '#tag'. Unlike crops, ocean and cave biomes match.
category        for 'set' when the mob is added: monster, creature, ambient, water_creature, water_ambient,
underground_water_creature, axolotls, misc
disable_modifiers  a mod's own biome modifiers this rule replaces (each becomes forge:none). Optional.
label, notes    shown in the report, for the reader.
conditions: [ { ... }, ... ]   spawn checks instead of biome lists (patcherMod worldgen/SpawnConditions). Natural spawns
and chunk-generation herds only; spawn eggs, spawners and commands are untouched.
id         unique, lowercase a-z 0-9 _ (names the biome tag creativeengineering:spawn_conditions/<id>)
condition  light_only  the mob's spawn rule becomes 'light above 8' on any block its placement allows (no ground
block requirement). Its own check (Alex's Mobs' 1-in-N roll) still runs.
water_only  only on the water surface (top block of the column is water). Its own rule still runs.
mobs       entity ids. Ids of a mod that isn't loaded are left out.
where / add / except / rules   where it applies, as for rules; 'rules' = the biomes those rule ids match.
None of them = everywhere.
spawn_ground: { block tag: [entries] }   blocks added to a spawn-rule ground tag (ids or '#tags'), e.g.
#minecraft:animals_spawnable_on, which vanilla animals and many Alex's Mobs animals need below them.
patcherMod makes Animal's (and the mooshroom's) walk value read the same tag, so night spawns agree.
Weights are relative to the other mobs of the same category in that biome (plains creatures: sheep 12, pig 10,
chicken 10, cow 8, horse 5, donkey 1; one picked per spawn attempt). See mob_spawns.md section 2 for what else
decides whether a picked mob actually appears (light, ground block, mob cap).

rules.label: Plan 9.1
rules.notes: Mooshrooms in dark forests and the mirage isles. Needs spawn_ground: their rule wants #mooshrooms_spawnable_on below (mycelium only in vanilla).

rules.label: Plan 9.3
rules.notes: Sheep favour hills and peaks (every mountain-trait biome; peaks are a subset).

rules.label: Plan 9.3
rules.notes: Cows favour plains and flat biomes. Also doubles mooblooms where More Mooblooms converts plains cows (meadow, blooming plateau).

rules.label: Plan 9.3
rules.notes: Chickens on beaches and river banks; the chicken_shores condition lets them spawn on sand and gravel there.

rules.label: Plan 9.3
rules.notes: Chickens in every skylands biome, at twice the spring weight.

rules.label: Plan 9.3
rules.notes: Rabbits twice as common in snowy biomes that have them.

rules.label: Plan 9.6
rules.notes: Ducks in swamps and on beaches as on rivers (anywhere, daylight unless on grass).

rules.label: Plan 9.6
rules.notes: Geese in swamps and on beaches as on rivers.

rules.label: Plan 9.6
rules.notes: Ducks on lakes and ponds in grassy land biomes: the waterfowl_ponds condition only lets them spawn on water there.

rules.label: Plan 9.6
rules.notes: Geese on lakes and ponds, as duck_ponds.

conditions.label: Plan 9.5
conditions.notes: Flying birds need only light, not a ground block. Everywhere.

conditions.label: Plan 9.3
conditions.notes: Chickens on sand and gravel on beaches and river banks (elsewhere they keep the ground rule).

conditions.label: Plan 9.6
conditions.notes: In grassy land biomes ducks and geese spawn only on water, so they turn up on lakes and ponds. Rivers, swamps and beaches are not in it.

spawn_ground._note: Plan 9.2: every dirt (#minecraft:dirt: dirt, coarse dirt, podzol, rooted dirt, mycelium, moss, mud, Immersive Weathering soils, Botania grasses...) counts as ground for animals, mooshrooms and rabbits.
